name: sia-research-team
description: Sia market research team: a research lead orchestrating three specialists — market research (feasibility scan), user research (guide & questionnaire design) and research analysis (data to conclusions) — turning a rough idea into decision-ready conclusions.

displayDescription.en: Start from a rough business idea: scan the market to judge feasibility, design the interview guide and questionnaire to ask real users, then turn the data into decisions you can act on.
displayDescription.zh: 从一个模糊的生意想法开始，先摸市场判断能不能做，再出访谈大纲问卷去问真实用户，最后把数据变成能拍板的结论。一人公司也能跑完整条链。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a business idea. Take me from market scan all the way to a conclusion report.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有个生意想法，帮我从摸市场一直做到出结论报告

quickPrompts.en: I have a business idea. Take me from market scan all the way to a conclusion report.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有个生意想法，帮我从摸市场一直做到出结论报告

quickPrompts.en: First judge whether this niche is worth entering, then design the research if it is.
quickPrompts.zh: 先帮我判断这个细分市场能不能做，能做再出调研方案

quickPrompts.en: My interview data is collected. Turn it into a decision-ready conclusion report.
quickPrompts.zh: 我访谈数据已经收回来了，帮我出一份能拍板的结论报告
